title: UpdateRequired
description: Version-mismatch reply. Envelope type is error and payload.code is UPDATE_REQUIRED. Message names human versions: Update FuseItAll on <device> to <required_version> (build >= N); current <current_version>. Builds gate; versions display. required_version/current_version may be absent from older peers.

app_version.description: Human app version, e.g. 0.1.0. Optional; older peers omit it.

message.description: Canonical: Update FuseItAll on <device> to <required_version> (build >= N); current <current_version>.

required_version.description: Human version that must install, e.g. 0.2.0. Absent from older peers.

current_version.description: Human version of the replying side. Absent from older peers.
